data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'd-h-f', which means to help or support. In Islamic context, Dhaif is a name given to a person who is always ready to help others. The name Dhaif carries the meaning “Helper, Supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian.
